name: Assessment Level 1 (AL 1)
description: Mainly for internal purposes in the sense of a self-assessment; the auditor only checks for the existence of a completed self-assessment and does not assess its content; results have a low trust level and are not used in TISAX

name: Assessment Level 2 (AL 2)
description: The audit provider does a plausibility check on the self-assessment for all locations in scope, supported by checking evidence and an interview with the person in charge of information security; an on-site inspection is done at the participant's request

name: Assessment Level 3 (AL 3)
description: The audit provider does a comprehensive verification of compliance with the applicable requirements; the auditor examines documents and evidence, conducts planned and unplanned interviews, observes local conditions and the execution of processes; an on-site inspection is required
